output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Christian Jacobi is IBM’s Chief Technology Officer and IBM Fellow for IBM Systems Development. IBM’s own AI Academy page likewise identifies him as “IBM Fellow and CTO, Systems Development.” IBM’s corporate senior-leadership page does not list a separate company-wide CTO, so “IBM’s CTO” should be understood as referring to Jacobi’s Systems Development role rather than a corporate-wide title.
caveats: IBM’s official corporate senior-leadership roster does not show a distinct company-wide CTO title; IBM uses CTO titles for specific organizations and technical domains.
